note: Quest map for Anisha's Spooky House: Anisha's 45 tasks (A), the 59 approved suggestions (S), and the new quests (E easy, M medium, H hard, ST story, MJ major). 'difficulty' = items needed, rooms crossed, baddies awake and timing (see CLAUDE.md); 'series' (main/story/major) and 'kind' (prank/help/mystery/event/build) are separate from difficulty. 'original_text' + 'tone_edit' show where Anisha's wording was lightly changed for the cheerful tone. Room ids are the art pack's (godot/data/rooms); science_lab, granny_outside and the museum rooms (mu_hall, mu_dino_hall, mu_gallery, mu_store) are not in the pack yet. Not sorted by difficulty.

tasks.title: Help the Teddy
tasks.text: Teddy has a wobbly arm. Find Teddy on the Fluffy room bed, get a bandage from the hospital, and fix the arm.
tasks.learn: Bandages live in the hospital's first-aid box.
tasks.message: Looking after a friend's toy shows you care.

tasks.title: The Missing Football
tasks.text: Find a clue on the school notice board and follow it to the football at the playground.
tasks.learn: Notice boards share news and clues.
tasks.message: Reading carefully helps you find what is lost.

tasks.title: Paint the Playground Sign
tasks.text: Get paint and a brush from the school classroom, then paint the playground sign.
tasks.learn: Paint and brushes belong in the art corner at school.
tasks.message: Making a place look nice is a gift to everyone.

tasks.title: Surprise Party
tasks.text: Get balloons from home, find granny's secret decoration trick in her craft room, and decorate the dining room for a surprise party.
tasks.learn: Party things are kept at home; craft ideas are in the craft room.
tasks.message: A surprise made with love is the best present.
tasks.note: Granny must not see the party before it is ready.

tasks.title: Granny's Little Plant
tasks.text: Take the plant pot from your hall, get seeds from granny's garden, and plant them.
tasks.learn: Seeds and soil are found in the garden.
tasks.message: Plants grow when we look after them every day.

tasks.title: The Book Delivery
tasks.text: Pick up the lost book at the museum and take it back to the school library.
tasks.learn: Books go home to the library.
tasks.message: Returning things helps everyone find them again.

tasks.title: Clean the Museum Statue
tasks.text: Take a clean towel from your bathroom and wipe the dusty statue in the museum hall.
tasks.learn: Cloths and towels are kept in the bathroom.
tasks.message: Looking after old things keeps their stories shining.

tasks.title: The Doctor's Missing Stethoscope
tasks.text: The doctor left a stethoscope at your house. Find it in the Fluffy room and bring it back to the doctor's room at the hospital.
tasks.learn: A doctor's tools go back to the doctor's room.
tasks.message: When you find something that is not yours, give it back.

tasks.title: Granny's Recipe
tasks.text: Granny needs a recipe card. Get paper and a pencil from the school classroom and bring them to her kitchen.
tasks.learn: Paper and pencils are in the classroom.
tasks.message: Sharing a recipe shares a little love.

tasks.title: The Squeaky Chair Prank
tasks.text: Take the squeaky toy from your animal room and slip it under the scary teacher's chair at school.
tasks.learn: Toys that squeak live in the animal room.
tasks.message: A harmless giggle can brighten a grumpy day.

tasks.title: Squeaky Sofa
tasks.text: Hide a squeaky pet toy under the cushion of granny's hall sofa.
tasks.learn: Squeaky toys come from the animal room; sofas have cushions to hide things under.
tasks.message: A tiny squeak can make a whole room giggle.
tasks.note: First early-game home-to-granny's task. Uses only rooms open at Granny's room #2.

tasks.title: Feeding Time
tasks.text: The pets are hungry! Fill a food bowl for the dog, the cat and the parrot.
tasks.learn: Each pet has its own food and spot: seeds for the parrot, a bowl by the dog bed, a bowl by the cat basket.
tasks.message: Looking after animals makes them your friends, and friends help you back.
tasks.note: Calm task: no baddie. Three feeding spots in the Animal room (parrot cage, dog bed, cat basket). Reward: the pets become helpers who run out to distract a chaser in later tasks (rule 6). The room has 2 bowls in the pack, so one more bowl and the pet food are needed.
tasks.needs: The pet food in the animal room
tasks.watchOut: Nobody: it is a calm task
tasks.tip: Tip: each pet has its own bowl, by its bed, basket or cage.
tasks.completeText: Yum! Now the pets are your friends. They will help you when someone chases you.

tasks.title: Smiley Mirror
tasks.text: Take the soap from your bathroom and draw a big smiley face on the mirror in granny's bathroom.
tasks.learn: Soap and mirrors live in the bathroom.
tasks.message: A smile is the nicest surprise (and she wipes it off with a laugh).

tasks.title: Lost and Found
tasks.text: A swim ring and a football were left in granny's store room. Take the ring back to the pool and the ball back to the playground.
missing_objects: swim ring found in the store room
tasks.learn: Swim rings belong at the pool and balls belong at the playground.
tasks.message: Putting things back where they belong helps everyone.
tasks.note: Teaches 'which building does this belong in?'.

tasks.title: Googly-Eyed Statue
tasks.text: Stick a pair of big googly eyes on the statue in the museum hall.
tasks.learn: Craft supplies like googly eyes are in the craft room.
tasks.message: A silly face on a serious statue makes everyone smile.

tasks.title: Football in the Flower Pot
tasks.text: Hide the football inside the big plant pot in granny's store room.
tasks.learn: Footballs live at the playground; big pots are in the store room.
tasks.message: Hide-and-seek with a ball is a game, not a fight.

tasks.title: Royal Cat
tasks.text: Make a paper crown in granny's craft room and place it on the sleepy cat in your animal room.
tasks.learn: Paper and scissors are in the craft room.
tasks.message: Even a cat can be a king for a day.
tasks.note: Decided (Dharmesh): the scary teacher visits for tea, so there is someone at home to keep the stakes.

tasks.title: Silly Portrait
tasks.text: Clip a silly drawing with a big moustache over a royal painting in the palace throne room.
tasks.learn: Paper, pencils and clips are found in the craft room.
tasks.message: Even royal faces enjoy a joke.

tasks.title: Emergency Teddy Rescue
tasks.text: Teddy fell off the playground slide! Get an ice pack from your house and a bandage from the hospital, then help Teddy.
tasks.learn: Ice packs are for bumps (at home) and bandages are for scratches (at the hospital).
tasks.message: Being kind and quick helps a friend feel better.

tasks.title: Fix the Broken Bicycle
tasks.text: A bicycle at the playground has a wobbly wheel and its rider has a scratch. Bring tools from your house and a bandage from the hospital.
tasks.learn: Tools live in the toolbox at home; bandages live at the hospital.
tasks.message: Fixing things and helping people makes you a hero.
tasks.note: Needs a toolbox in the little house hall (not in the pack).

tasks.title: Mini Playground Festival
tasks.text: School gives the decorations, granny gives the snacks, and you set up a little festival at the playground.
tasks.learn: Snacks come from the kitchen and decorations come from school.
tasks.message: Parties are happier when everyone brings something.

tasks.title: Restore the Painting
tasks.text: A museum painting has a faded corner. Get a brush from school and old paint from granny's craft room, then touch it up.
tasks.learn: Art tools are at school and in the craft room.
tasks.message: Fixing old art keeps its beauty for everyone.

tasks.title: Who Took the Giant Spoon?
tasks.text: The museum's giant spoon is missing! Follow funny clues from granny's kitchen and the school science lab to find who borrowed it for an experiment.
tasks.learn: Spoons live in the kitchen and experiments happen in the science lab.
tasks.message: Asking questions kindly solves a mystery.

tasks.title: The Sleeping Guard Prank
tasks.text: Get a toy moustache from home and a funny hat from school, then dress up the museum guard's statue.
tasks.learn: Dress-up things are at home and hats are in school's lost property.
tasks.message: Making people smile is the best kind of mischief.

tasks.title: The Impossible Birthday Cake
tasks.text: Granny writes the recipe, the school canteen lends a measuring cup, you bake in granny's kitchen and carry the cake home.
tasks.learn: Cooking tools are in the kitchen and canteen.
tasks.message: Baking for someone is a way to say I love you.
tasks.note: The little house has no kitchen, so the baking happens at granny's. DECISION: or add a kitchen corner at home.

tasks.title: School Sports Day
tasks.text: Get a whistle from school, water bottles from home, and the football from the playground, then start the sports event.
tasks.learn: Whistles belong to PE teachers at school; bottles are kept at home.
tasks.message: Playing together matters more than winning.

tasks.title: Grow a Giant Flower
tasks.text: Get a seed from granny's garden, a pot from home and a bottle of 'plant medicine' from the hospital pharmacy, and grow a giant flower.
tasks.learn: Plants need water, light and care, like people.
tasks.message: Patience and care help big things grow.

tasks.title: Museum Detective
tasks.text: Find a mysterious object in the museum, borrow a magnifying glass from the school science lab, then ask granny what the object is.
tasks.learn: Magnifying glasses and microscopes live in the science lab.
tasks.message: Looking closely helps us understand the past.

tasks.title: The Fizzy Science Trick
tasks.text: Collect lemon and a pinch of baking soda from granny's kitchen and soap from home, then put on a fizzy bubbling show in the school science lab.
tasks.learn: Lemons and soda are in the kitchen; flasks are in the science lab.
tasks.message: Science is more fun when we try it safely.

tasks.title: The Museum Ghost Prank
tasks.text: Make a friendly sheet ghost at home and hide it behind a museum exhibit to surprise your friends.
tasks.learn: Sheets are at home; eyes can be cut from paper at school.
tasks.message: A friendly 'boo' makes friends laugh, not scream.
tasks.note: A friendly ghost: the spooky look stays in Granny's house only.

tasks.title: Funny Labels
tasks.text: Get sticker labels from school and put funny names under the museum exhibits (granny's slipper, anyone?).
tasks.learn: Labels and stickers are kept at school.
tasks.message: Silly names help us notice what is really there.

tasks.title: Sandcastle Flag
tasks.text: Make a flag from coloured paper (granny's craft room) and a pencil (school) and plant it on top of the sandcastle.
tasks.learn: Paper is in the craft room and pencils are at school.
tasks.message: Making something yourself feels great.

tasks.title: Ward Cheer-Up

tasks.learn: Soft things comfort people; toys are in the Fluffy room.
tasks.message: Sharing something you love can make someone's day.

tasks.title: Lemonade Stall
tasks.text: Get lemons and sugar from granny's kitchen, cups from the school canteen, and set up a lemonade stall at the playground.
tasks.learn: Lemons and sugar are in the kitchen; cups are in the canteen.
tasks.message: Sharing a cold drink makes new friends.

tasks.title: The Talking Dinosaur
tasks.text: Hide a tiny animal-sound speaker in the museum dinosaur's mouth so it 'talks' when visitors walk by.
tasks.learn: Sound toys are in the animal room.
tasks.message: A surprise voice makes learning about dinosaurs fun.

tasks.title: The Quacking Bell
tasks.text: Tie a squeaky duck toy to the school bell so it quacks when it rings.
tasks.learn: Squeaky toys live in the animal room; the school bell hangs in the corridor.
tasks.message: A quack can cheer up even Monday.

tasks.title: Doctor Teddy
tasks.text: Dress Teddy as a doctor with a paper mask and the doctor's stethoscope, then sit Teddy in the hospital reception.
tasks.learn: Stethoscopes live in the doctor's room.
tasks.message: A friendly toy doctor can make a visit less scary.

tasks.title: The Great Treasure Hunt
tasks.text: The museum gives the first clue, school solves a picture clue, granny gives the map, and the treasure is buried at the playground.
tasks.learn: Follow the clues one place at a time.
tasks.message: The best treasure is the fun of searching together.

tasks.title: The Missing Crown
tasks.text: The palace crown is missing! Find a clue at the museum, decode a symbol at school, ask granny where it was last seen, and bring it back.
tasks.learn: Libraries help us read symbols; grannies remember old stories.
tasks.message: Everyone helps when something precious is lost.

tasks.title: The Flying Balloon Machine
tasks.text: Collect string from home, paper from school and a strange material from the museum, and build a balloon decoration that floats at the playground.
tasks.learn: String is at home, paper at school and curiosities in the museum.
tasks.message: Inventing starts with simple things.

tasks.title: Rescue the Lost Teddy
tasks.text: Find a toy at the playground, discover its owner at school, follow a hospital clue, and let granny tell you where the child went.
tasks.learn: Lost toys are returned by asking at school and the hospital.
tasks.message: Helping a lost toy find its friend is a kindness.

tasks.title: The Royal Prank
tasks.text: Make a funny royal costume from home, borrow a prop from the museum, make a paper crown at school, and surprise the palace characters.
tasks.learn: Dress-up is at home; props are at the museum.
tasks.message: Dressing up and laughing together is royal fun.

tasks.title: Build a Secret Treehouse
tasks.text: Collect wood from the playground, tools from home, rope from granny's store room and decorations from school, then build a secret treehouse in granny's garden.
tasks.learn: Wood, tools and rope all come from different places.
tasks.message: Building together makes a place to share.

tasks.title: The Backyard Space Mission
tasks.text: Build a cardboard rocket from granny's store room, get supplies from school, collect a 'space artifact' from the museum and launch a pretend mission at the playground.
tasks.learn: Big cardboard boxes are in the store room.
tasks.message: Pretending together can take you anywhere.
tasks.note: Related to level 2 (A2): same rocket, friendlier launch.

tasks.title: The Dinosaur Mystery
tasks.text: The museum finds a footprint. School looks it up, the hospital X-ray room shows what is inside, and granny remembers an old story.
tasks.learn: Libraries explain things; X-ray machines show bones.
tasks.message: Scientists and doctors both study bones.
tasks.note: Changed from the original (a hospital 'magnifier') to the X-ray room, which exists in the pack.

tasks.title: The Biggest Party Ever
tasks.text: Bring food from granny, decorations from home, games from the playground and an invitation from school, then throw a giant town party at the palace.
tasks.learn: A party needs food, decorations, games and invitations from different places.
tasks.message: A party is better when everyone is invited.

tasks.title: The Secret Town Map
tasks.text: Find map pieces in every building, put them together, and discover a hidden spot.
tasks.learn: Every building holds one piece of the story.
tasks.message: A big picture is made of small pieces.
tasks.note: DECISION: what is the hidden spot (Secret Clubhouse, see MJ5)?

tasks.title: The Great Mix-up
tasks.text: Five things are in the wrong building: a towel in the museum, a stethoscope at school, a book at granny's, a football at the pool and a crown at home. Put each one back where it belongs.
tasks.learn: Everything has a home: towels at the pool, stethoscopes at the hospital, books at the library, balls at the playground, crowns at the palace.
tasks.message: Tidying up is teamwork.
tasks.note: The 'where do things belong?' quest in one. Deliveries: pool, hospital, library, playground, palace.

tasks.title: Welcome to the Town
tasks.text: Ride through town for the first time: your house, granny's hall and the playground.
tasks.learn: A town has places for everything: homes, parks and streets.
tasks.message: A new town is friendlier when you say hello.
tasks.note: Changed from House > School > Playground to match the unlock order (the school opens at level 45).

tasks.title: Granny Needs Help
tasks.text: Granny can't find her reading glasses. Look at home, then at the hospital doctor's room (the eye chart!).
tasks.learn: Eye charts and glasses belong to the doctor's room.
tasks.message: Helping family find things is a way to say thank you.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Playground Mystery
tasks.text: Something strange squeaks at the playground at night. Follow the clues through school and home.
tasks.learn: Clues lead from one place to the next.
tasks.message: Mysteries are friendlier when you ask kindly.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Museum's Secret
tasks.text: You find an old object in the museum. School and granny help you work out its story.
tasks.learn: Libraries and grannies both hold stories.
tasks.message: Old things have stories worth hearing.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Palace Invitation
tasks.text: A palace invitation arrives! Find the museum's royal etiquette book and a school-made gift before you go.
tasks.learn: Gifts can be made by hand at school.
tasks.message: A handmade gift is a royal present.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Missing Character
tasks.text: Kamala has disappeared! Follow clues from the playground, school and hospital, and ask granny where she went.
tasks.learn: Asking people in each place finds what you need.
tasks.message: Friends look for friends.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Town Festival
tasks.text: Everyone brings something: your house, granny, the school, the playground and the palace.
tasks.learn: A festival needs a bit of everything.
tasks.message: Many hands make a happy festival.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: The Secret Behind the Museum
tasks.text: A bigger mystery begins behind the museum: granny, school and the palace each know a piece.
tasks.learn: Big mysteries need many helpers.
tasks.message: Old secrets belong to everyone.
tasks.note: Story quest: the steps get designed one task at a time.

tasks.title: Build the Community Playground
tasks.text: Collect tools (house), wood (playground), a design (school), plants (granny) and a first-aid box (hospital), then build a new playground area.
tasks.learn: Every part of a project comes from a different place.
tasks.message: A place built together belongs to everyone.
tasks.unlocks: a new playground area with new characters and new games
tasks.note: Major quest: built from several smaller tasks.

tasks.title: The Grand Town Festival
tasks.text: Every building adds one thing: first-aid booth, decorations, games, equipment, food, a museum display and the palace's festival funds.
tasks.learn: A festival is built from lots of different jobs.
tasks.message: A happy town is one where everyone helps.
tasks.unlocks: the Town Festival: all characters appear together
tasks.note: Major quest: built from several smaller tasks.

tasks.title: The Museum Grand Opening
tasks.text: Collect a historical object, an information board, an old photograph, a royal item and a display frame, and build the exhibition.
tasks.learn: Museums keep objects, photos and stories safe.
tasks.message: Sharing old things teaches new things.
tasks.note: Major quest: built from several smaller tasks.

tasks.title: The Royal Treasure Hunt
tasks.text: The palace gives you an old treasure map. Pieces are spread around town, and the final spot is the playground, where you find a giant box of funny prank supplies!
tasks.learn: Maps help us find places.
tasks.message: Sharing a treasure is the best treasure.
tasks.unlocks: a box of funny prank supplies for later tasks
tasks.note: Major quest: built from several smaller tasks.

tasks.title: Build the Secret Clubhouse
tasks.text: Each building gives one thing: first-aid kit, books, sports gear, tools, decorations, a mysterious old object and a special palace key.
tasks.learn: A clubhouse is made from lots of different things.
tasks.message: A secret place is better when you share the key.
tasks.unlocks: a permanent Secret Clubhouse where future quests begin
tasks.note: Major quest: built from several smaller tasks.

tasks.title: Good Morning
tasks.text: Get ready for school in order: fold your bed, brush your teeth, take a shower, then put on your uniform and pick up your school bag.
tasks.learn: Each job has its own room: beds in the bedroom, teeth and showers in the bathroom, school things by the door.
tasks.message: Good morning habits make the whole day happier.
tasks.note: Calm tutorial task: no baddie and nothing to get caught by. Four steps in order: Fluffy room bed, bathroom toothbrush, shower, then the Hall for the uniform and bag. Teaches walking, picking up and using items. Could be the very first task, before level 1.

steps.text: Get your school uniform from the sofa

tasks.watchOut: Nobody: it is a calm morning
tasks.tip: Tip: the list tells you what comes next. Walk up to things and press E.
tasks.completeText: Ready for school! Good morning, Anisha.

tasks.title: Tidy the Fluffy Room
tasks.text: The Fluffy room is in a muddle! Put the 3 soft toys in the toy box, the 2 cushions on the bean bag, and switch on the fairy lights when it is neat.
tasks.learn: Everything has a place: toys go in the toy box, cushions go on the bean bag.
tasks.message: A tidy room is a happy room, and tidying is quicker when you do it with a smile.
tasks.note: Calm task: no baddie. Tidy-up by picking up and putting down items; the lights switch on at the end as the reward. Pairs with Good Morning (E19), which folds the bed in the same room. The toy box is also where later quests keep dress-up things, so it is worth adding anyway.

steps.text: Put it in the toy box
Pick up the next soft toy
Put it in the toy box
Pick up the last soft toy
Put it in the toy box
Put it on the bean bag
Put it on the bean bag

tasks.needs: Nothing: it is all in the room
tasks.watchOut: Nobody: it is a calm task
tasks.tip: Tip: toys go in the toy box, cushions go on the bean bag.
tasks.completeText: The fairy lights glow. What a cosy room!

tasks.title: Water the Hall Plant
tasks.text: The plant in the Hall looks droopy. Fill the watering can from the bathroom tap, carry it to the Hall, and give the plant a drink.
tasks.learn: Water comes from the tap in the bathroom, and plants live where there is light.
tasks.message: Plants need a little care every day, just like pets and people.
tasks.note: Calm task: no baddie. Fetch, carry, use. The plant perks up when watered. Later, E5 (Granny's Little Plant) reuses this same pot, so Anisha already knows how to look after it.

steps.text: Water the plant in the Hall

tasks.needs: The watering can in the bathroom
tasks.watchOut: Nobody: it is a calm task
tasks.tip: Tip: the water comes from the bathroom tap. Fill the can first.
tasks.completeText: The plant lifts its leaves. Thank you, Anisha!

tasks.title: Bath Time for Teddy
tasks.text: Teddy got dusty from the playground! Take Teddy to the bathroom, wash Teddy with soap in the bathtub, dry Teddy with the towel, and put Teddy back on the Fluffy room bed.
tasks.learn: Washing happens in the bathroom with soap and water, and a towel dries things afterwards.
tasks.message: Keeping your things clean shows you care about them.
tasks.note: Calm task: no baddie. Four steps in order (fetch Teddy, wash, dry, return). Uses the soap, bathtub and towel already in the bathroom. Teddy is also the character in E1 and M1, so Anisha meets Teddy here first.

steps.text: Pick up Teddy from the bed
Put Teddy back on the bed

tasks.watchOut: Nobody: it is a calm task
tasks.tip: Tip: soap first, then the towel.
tasks.completeText: Teddy is clean, fluffy and very happy.

tasks.title: Squeaky Doormat
tasks.text: The scary teacher is coming for tea! Take the squeaky toy from the Animal room and hide it under the Hall doormat, then wait out of sight until she steps on it.
tasks.learn: Squeaky toys live in the animal room, and a doormat is the first thing a visitor steps on.
tasks.message: A harmless squeak is a funny welcome, and she laughs too.
tasks.note: Decided (Dharmesh): the scary teacher visits for tea, so the house has someone to prank and the stakes stay. She walks a slow patrol from the front door through the Hall. Anisha can hide behind the sofa or in the Fluffy room (the bed is a hiding spot). If she is seen planting it she is caught and replays. The first easy home prank, and the home version of E10 (the squeaky chair at school).

steps.text: Hide behind the sofa and wait for the teacher

tasks.needs: The squeaky toy from the animal room
tasks.hideIn: Behind the sofa, or the Fluffy room bed
tasks.tip: Tip: she comes in through the front door. Hide behind the sofa (press H).
tasks.completeText: SQUEAK! She jumps, then laughs. 'Very funny, Anisha!'
